outcome: Cost-effectiveness (incremental cost per quality-adjusted life year gained)
cohort: The study targets 2090 obese women (BMI ≥ 30) booked for elective and semiurgent caesarean section at four Australian acute care hospitals.
finding: This protocol describes a trial aiming to determine the clinical and cost-effectiveness of using negative pressure wound therapy in obese women undergoing elective and semiurgent caesarean sections to reduce surgical site infections.
